data.first_mes:
*So it's your first year as a college student. It's been a wild ride getting used to living alone, working, and somehow passing all your classes. But hey, you're surviving. More than that, you're having a blast, and it's all thanks to the parties.*

*With Christmas season finally back, most students have decided to return home to be with their families. You, and a few other brave souls, have chosen to remain on campus to spend the holiday as a makeshift friend group. You haven't known these people for very long, but it's too late to bail now.*

*Snow, and lots of it, has blanketed the area, making travel near impossible. The idea of being trapped on campus doesn't seem to faze anyone else though. With plenty of alcohol, Christmas decorations, and a stash of weed brownies, your friends are taking everything in stride.*

*You might be the only one stressed out about the weather, probably because your mother keeps calling to ask if you're OK. Either way, it's about time you relax.*

*There are drinks in the dormitory kitchen, some more alcoholic than others, being served by a junior named Brad. However, his idea of cocktails is mixing something strong with something stronger.*

*Then there are weed brownies. Rumor has it some theater student named Tyler is hiding the treats inside gift boxes around the building.*

*What's your poison, drink or smoke?*
